question: The first Khelo India Youth Games were organized in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first edition** of the **Khelo India Youth Games** (then known as **Khelo India School Games**) was held in **New Delhi** in **2018**.
 
• The event was inaugurated by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on **January 31, 2018**, at the **Indira Gandhi Arena**.
 
• In this inaugural edition, **Haryana** topped the medal tally by winning a total of **102 medals**, including **38 gold**, **26 silver**, and **38 bronze** medals.
 
• **Maharashtra** finished second in the overall standings, while the host city, **Delhi**, secured the third position.
 
• The games were organized to identify and nurture sporting talent at the **grassroots level**, featuring **16 different sports disciplines** such as **Athletics**, **Archery**, **Badminton**, **Boxing**, **Football**, and **Wrestling**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Evolution of the Games**:

 
 
• Following the success of the school games, the second edition in **2019** was renamed the **Khelo India Youth Games** to include a category for **college students** (Under-21) alongside **school students** (Under-17).
 
• The **second edition** was hosted in **Pune, Maharashtra**, in **January 2019**, where **Maharashtra** emerged as the champion.
 
 
 
• **Venue History**:
 
 
• The **third edition** took place in **Guwahati, Assam**, in **2020**.
 
• The **fourth edition** was held in **Panchkula, Haryana**, in **June 2022** (postponed from 2021 due to the pandemic).
 
• The **fifth edition** was organized across multiple cities in **Madhya Pradesh** in **2023**, and the **sixth edition** was held in **Tamil Nadu** in **January 2024**.
 
 
 
• **Scholarship and Support**:
 
 
• Under the **Khelo India** initiative, talented players identified in priority sports disciplines are provided with an **annual financial assistance** of **Rs. 5 lakh** per annum for **8 years**.
 
• The program is a flagship initiative of the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, aimed at reviving the sports culture in India at the **local level**.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India University Games (KIUG)**:
 
 
• In addition to the youth games, the government launched the **Khelo India University Games** in **2020**, with the first edition held in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**, to promote sports at the university level.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Management**: The games are conducted by the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** in collaboration with the respective **State Governments** and **National Sports Federations**.
 
• **Objective**: The primary goal is the **mass participation** of youth and the promotion of **excellence in sports**, acting as a feeder for international events like the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**.
 
• **Inclusion**: Over the years, indigenous sports like **Gatka**, **Kalaripayattu**, **Thang-Ta**, **Mallakhamba**, and **Yogasana** have been included to preserve and promote **India's traditional sports heritage**.
